$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for library/ourairports, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the shapes descriptor.overrides.json publishes on code, code_display, gps_code, iso_country and release; the closed `enum` domains on level, text_source, type and continent, so a new airport type or continent code fails the run for a person to describe; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes on the names. NOT ENFORCED, by design: depth, ourairports_id, latitude_deg, longitude_deg, elevation_ft and scheduled_service (a numeric or boolean `type` BACKFIRES to 100% reject once melted to VARCHAR; load.sql checks the coordinates' range and the elevation's integer shape); ident, iso_region, local_code and the links, whose shapes OurAirports does not fix; NULLs (invisible to ft_validate); object-level `required` (documentation only). Derived from build/stage/ourairports.parquet: a pass-through on 2026-11-16's 10,734 rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift.
title: library/ourairports
